items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t recall that. ... I don’t remember that. I remember the title, but I don’t – just don’t remember the recording.

ctx.x: Then Chet Baker, a session with Chet Baker at Rudy Van Gelder’s. Then here comes Ron Carter, Spanish Blue.
I don’t remember that. I remember the title, but I don’t – I just don’t remember the recording.
